input.request: I need a copy of the bank record for my £74.00 payment to a repair contractor, so I can share evidence of the payment with them. I can see the transaction in my secure portal, but need a document showing its current stage.

events.text: I show an outgoing payment of £74.00 dated 14 July 2025 in your transaction history. Its reference is HV-040 and its bank status is SENT.

summary: The customer asked for a document showing the current stage of their £74.00 payment to a repair contractor, so they could share evidence of it. The desk classified it as a document request and sent a query to the documents system about the £74.00 payment. The case closed as asked, and the bank's record showed the payment as sent on 14 July 2025 with reference HV-040. The desk's attempt to send a reply was refused because the case was already closed, so no reply went out and nothing in the record shows the document being produced or delivered.
